plan.notes: Recommended Course Sequence published on catalog pp. 240-241 of the official 2023-2024 catalog; AA in Humanities. MATH 15 is labeled 'Major' (COA GE area 4B) — kept verbatim per standard. 'Major Elective' maps to major. PHIL 10 (Logic) lists no prerequisite, so the PHIL 10/COMM 5 choice codes no prereq (the COMM 5 alternative requires ENGL 1A, sequenced in Fall Y1 regardless). No other hard prerequisites in this sequence. Computed total 60. Revalidated 2026-10-01 against the official College of Alameda 2024-2025 catalog (CoA-Catalog-24-25_PRINT_v1.pdf, 7,590,937 bytes, 416 pages; live alameda.edu copy 404s, retrieved via Wayback Machine capture 20250808180750): recommended course sequence verified identical to the 2023-2024 transcription. The 2025-2026 catalog is published only on Curriqunet (JS-rendered, no downloadable PDF); revalidation against it is pending a live-browser pass.
